# HLPatcher

> Free, open-source patcher that makes Half-Life and other Valve games run natively on Apple Silicon Macs (M1 and newer).

## Docs

- [Home](https://hlpatcher.kzl21.ovh/): What HLPatcher is, supported games and credits
- [Getting Started](https://hlpatcher.kzl21.ovh/getting-started/): Download HLPatcher and patch your games
- [Removing Patches](https://hlpatcher.kzl21.ovh/removing-patches/): Restore your original game files
- [Contributing](https://hlpatcher.kzl21.ovh/contributing/): Development setup, testing and pull requests
